lines.1: The whole class is in an uproar over that silver-haired girl.
lines.2: Our homeroom teacher, Inori, is apparently late as usual.
lines.3: Normally the class rep, Sato, or Mr. Tsuchinaga would calm everyone down, but the two of them left the classroom together earlier.
lines.4: Still, what was that girl all about? Come to think of it, she was wearing our uniform. Which means--
lines.5: 「Good grief, you chicks are chirping up a storm. If you don't quiet down, I won't be able to introduce my new girlfriend.」
lines.6: Mr. Tsuchinaga returns to the classroom.
lines.10: Looks like they've brought someone to class--
lines.12: The person who enters is that same silver-haired girl from the schoolyard.
lines.15: 「All right, then. This is our transfer student, Serebu Tachibana. Why don't you introduce yourself?」
lines.16: Mr. Tsuchinaga's voice snaps me out of my trance. I'd been completely mesmerized by her proud, dignified gaze.
lines.22: 「That's how shy girls are. Now then, take any open seat.」
lines.26: Tachibana swiftly sits down in the seat next to mine.
lines.27: 「Good for you, Leo. Daddy is so happy.」
lines.30: this is a girl who just fought Otome on even terms. Having her in the seat beside me could not be more dangerous.
lines.32: Then again, if I think of it as getting to sit next to a beauty like this, maybe I'm incredibly lucky.
lines.34: Every class through third period is self-study. Apparently the teachers are all busy dealing with this morning's warship incident.
lines.35: Everyone is interested in Tachibana, but knowing about her clash with Otome this morning, no one dares casually approach her.
lines.36: And that includes me, even though I'm sitting right beside her.
